rationale: Earned iteration-2 Mastery (recovery, not a first-pass clean like ch-01). The decisive iteration-1 gap — the density-value error (SFT as O(1)) — was recovered UNDER THE LEARNER'S OWN POWER in qa Q10: they independently separated the two reductions (soft->hard bits-per-token vs O(N)->O(1) density) and concluded that output-tokens-only stays O(N), which is exactly the distinction they'd inverted. off-policy-vs-offline also recovered (re-probe (i) said 'off-policy', not 'offline'). The compounding failure that P3 never landed in iteration-1 was articulated cleanly in (ii): an unseen moment -> mishandled objection -> the mistake becomes context for subsequent turns -> continuous quality degradation, i.e. the ch-01-P2 feed-forward mechanism applied to boson. NOT rendered on the learner's request to 'change it to Mastery' — that was declined; this was re-measured via the re-probe. Some precision still needed correction/teaching along the way (see gaps), so this is a genuine but not-pristine Mastery.
evidence: Density recovery (the core gap) — self-driven: qa Q10 independently split 'soft->hard' (bits/token) from 'O(N)->O(1)' (density), correctly holding that output-tokens-only = hard-per-token = still O(N), and that O(1) requires collapsing to one whole-sequence scalar (RL). Re-probe (i) then gave density = O(N).
off-policy-vs-offline recovered: re-probe (i) labeled boson 'off-policy distillation' (not 'offline' as in iteration-1).

Compounding failure landed (ii): unseen moment -> wrong objection handling -> following responses conditioned on that mistake -> continuous quality degradation over turns = ch-01 P2's feed-forward exposure-bias mechanism, correctly transferred to boson.

Strong forward synthesis during re-anchoring: qa Q8 re-derived the on-policy-distillation recipe (student generates + reverse KL vs a stronger, queryable teacher + iterate) and correctly flagged that a self-teacher = mere reference-KL; Q9 realized reverse-KL needs the full per-token distribution, not the output token; Q10 connected cross-family = tokenizer misalignment -> forced to sequence-level/GOLD.
gaps: Boson artifact mapping needed teaching (missed 3x): the 'teacher beam-search mode' = the exported TRANSCRIPTS (teacher's generated output), not the 'predefined scenario' (that is the input/source s) nor 'teacher distribution' (what seq-KD approximates away from). Concept understood; the boson-specific mapping was supplied by the teacher.
Label precision: gave 'off-policy distillation'; the exact classification is off-policy SEQUENCE-LEVEL KD (whole-transcript CE, not per-token soft) — 'sequence-level' was missing.
Axis-value phrasing: stated data source as 'teacher model' (the source) rather than the axis VALUE 'off-policy' — minor but recurring; watch that axis coordinates are named as values, not sources.

Pattern to watch: precision on the three axes degrades under discuss load even when the concepts are held (this drove the iteration-1 Partial). ch-03 builds O(eps*T^2) on these axes; keep re-grounding density=O(N) and off-policy(!=offline) as reflexes.
